**ABOUT THE JOB**
-----------------


As a Full Stack Developer, you will design and maintain responsive web applications to support operational security solutions. You will work within our Production Security service to ensure the efficient control of network, server, and endpoint infrastructures.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------


* Design and develop responsive web applications using HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
* Implement UI components, state management, and routing while ensuring accessibility (WCAG).
* Integrate RESTful or GraphQL APIs by collaborating with back\-end teams to define technical contracts.
* Write clean, testable code and participate in regular code reviews.
* Contribute to back\-end services using .NET Core or other stacks when required.
* Mentor junior developers and share front\-end best practices within the team.

**PROFILE \& SKILLS**
---------------------


**Education \& Experience**


* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or an equivalent field.
* You have at least 3 years of professional experience in front\-end development.

**Technical Skills**


* You are proficient in at least one major front\-end framework, preferably React.
* You have a strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript, ES6\+, and modern build tools.
* You have a solid understanding of HTML5 semantics and CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, Sass/Less).
* You are experienced with Git and collaborative CI/CD workflows.
* You can write unit and integration tests using tools like Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.

**Preferred Skills**


* You have hands\-on experience with .NET Core/ASP.NET Web API (C\#).
* You are familiar with Docker and Kubernetes.
* You have knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* You have experience with GraphQL or real\-time technologies like WebSockets.

**Languages \& Soft Skills**


* You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* You have strong problem\-solving skills and high attention to detail.
* You demonstrate effective communication and teamwork abilities.

**️**
-----


**WHY JOIN BNP PARIBAS?**
-------------------------


We are BNP Paribas, a leading international bank present in 64 countries. We support our clients through financing, investment, savings, and insurance services, maintaining key positions in Corporate \& Institutional Banking.


In our Spain IT Production area, we ensure the reliability and security of the technological backbone that powers our financial services. We focus on delivering excellence in operational stability.


**OUR PERKS**


* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional development.
* Flexible working arrangements.
* International and multicultural work environment.
* Strong commitment to diversity and inclusion.

https://group.bnpparibas/en/our\-commitments/inclusion/diversity\-equality\-and\-inclusion


**Ready to make a difference? APPLY NOW!**
------------------------------------------


**Next steps: How does our recruitment process work?**


* We will assess the knowledge and experience highlighted in your CV to validate your fit for the role.


* The Human Resources team will contact you to confirm key details about the position.


* After this initial contact, interviews will be conducted with the relevant business area.


* We will get in touch with you to communicate the final decision of the process.

jobs.description:
**About Us**


At **Nextlane**, we don’t just develop software solutions – we **create the future** of the automotive industry.


We are a company that combines **advanced technology** with a clear vision: **simplifying and digitizing** every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.


We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to **develop** and contribute to meaningful solutions.


So… What does it mean to be a \#Nextlaner?

* Be part of a **g**rowth\-oriented culture.
* Collaborate with **colleagues from all over the world.**
* Believe in **the P**ower of ideas and the **diversity of thought**.
* Be committed to provide an environment where you can **learn, grow, and collaborate** on projects that make a global impact.


Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.


At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to **innovate**, **push boundaries**, and **work on solutions that are transforming** the automotive world.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Own the design, development, and delivery of complex features and systems across our applications.

* Build scalable, maintainable, and high\-quality solutions using .Net and React/Next.
* Drive technical decisions, balancing business needs, delivery timelines, performance, and long\-term maintainability.
* Contribute to the evolution of our backend and frontend architecture, development practices, and engineering standards.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver outstanding user experiences.
* Lead complex functionalities and ensure applications remain reliable, secure, and performant.
* Define and improve testing, release, and quality practices to ensure safe and predictable delivery.
* Identify technical risks early and propose solutions that reduce complexity and support future growth.
* Lead refactoring and modernization initiatives that improve the health of the codebase.
* Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Act as a technical leader within the team, driving engineering excellence and helping raise the overall quality of our mobile platform.
**What We're Looking For:**

* Experience: 6\-8\+ years

* Languages**: English B2/C1**
* Communication: Strong communication skills, both verbal and written ability to influence technical decisions constructively.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including architecture, design patterns, testing, and system design.
* Proven ability to deliver complex features with a high degree of ownership and autonomy.
* Experience making architectural decisions and evaluating technical trade\-offs.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity in complex systems.
* A quality\-focused mindset with experience improving engineering practices and development processes.
* Experience mentoring engineers and collaborating effectively within cross\-functional teams.
* A quality\-focused mindset with experience improving engineering practices and development processes.
**Technical Skills:**

* Strong professional experience developing **backend services with .Net.**
* Good experience developing **frontend application on React/Next**
* Proven experience building, maintaining, and scaling production applications
* Strong understanding of code architecture, design patterns, state management, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization. Understanding clean architecture and SOLID principles.
* Experience designing and implementing automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, and UI tests.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and mobile release processes.
* Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including code quality, maintainability, security, and observability.
* Experience working with Git\-based development workflows and collaborative engineering practices.
* Familiarity with analytics, performance monitoring, and feature flagging solutions.
* Ability to evaluate technical trade\-offs and contribute to architectural decisions across the mobile platform.
**Our Recruitment Process:**

* **Call** with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
* Technical Test
* Technical Interview
* Soft Skill interview with Hiring Manager

 **What We Offer:**


We understand that **flexibility and trust** are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* **Hybrid Work:** Rotational model, 2 days onsite, three days remote.
* **Annual Payments:** 14 payments per year (12 monthly payments \+ 1 summer bonus \+ 1 Christmas bonus in November).
* ️ **Meal Voucher:** €10\.20 per working day.
* **Vacation:** 23 vacation days, plus 24th or 31st December off.
* ️ **Language Training:** Access to group classes in Spanish, English, or French.
* ️ **Private Medical Insurance:** Multicare coverage.
* **Teambuilding:** Join us for memorable afterworks and team activities!

**Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging**


At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where **everyone feels valued and respected**. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

* **Support for people with disabilities**. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.
* **Equal opportunities for all:** We welcome applications regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Join **Nextlane** and become part of the technological revolution in the automotive industry.


Discover why we are a great place to develop your talent!

jobs.description:
At **Naphora Games Group**, we're building more than games, we're building a global team of ambitious, driven people who are hungry to learn, experiment, and raise the bar for the next generation of games.



We collaborate openly, move fast, and challenge ourselves every day to build better, smarter, and faster.



Our goal is to create world\-class games that players around the globe love and remember. If you thrive in a high\-performance, ownership\-driven environment and want to make a real impact, you'll fit right in with us.

**Role Summary:**



We're looking for a **Mid\-Senior Playable Programmer / Creative Technical Artist to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group** and help us create high\-performing playable ads and creative content for our mobile games.



This is a **fully remote position open to candidates from any location**, with availability to work in alignment with our Saudi Arabia working schedule (Sunday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM KSA time).



The role combines technical development and creative production, using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies to build, iterate, and optimize interactive playable experiences and performance\-focused video creatives.



Working closely with AI Engineering, Design, Marketing, UA, Product, Art, and Engineering, you'll be part of a fast\-paced environment where rapid experimentation, high\-volume testing, and iteration are a big part of how we work.



You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to our internal creative production and AI\-assisted tools and workflows, helping us find faster and more scalable ways to produce and test creatives.


### **Responsibilities**


**Playable Development \& Prototyping**


* Develop and maintain playable ads and gameplay prototypes using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies
* Build responsive gameplay interactions, UI flows, animations, visual feedback, and creative effects
* Rapidly prototype and iterate on gameplay and interactive creative concepts
* Build reusable gameplay systems, modular templates, components, and scalable architectures
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code where applicable
* Optimize playables for performance, loading time, file size, and cross\-device/platform compatibility


**Creative Production \& Performance**


* Create and iterate on video advertising creatives, gameplay\-based videos, and performance marketing assets
* Produce a high volume of playable and video creative variations for testing
* Iterate on creatives based on testing results, analytics, and UA performance
* Experiment with different gameplay concepts, creative formats, hooks, interactions, and technical approaches
* Support debugging, testing, analytics integrations, creative validation, and quality control


**AI, Tools \& Automation**


* Collaborate with AI Engineers on AI\-generated playable, video creative, and automation workflows
* Help develop, test, validate, and improve internal tools used for playable and creative production
* Explore AI\-assisted development and creative production workflows
* Experiment with new tools, engines, technologies, and approaches that can improve the speed and scale of creative production


**Collaboration**


* Work closely with Marketing, UA, Product, Design, Art, AI, and Engineering teams
* Translate creative concepts into technically feasible and engaging playable experiences
* Collaborate on creative testing and iteration based on performance data and learnings
* Contribute ideas and technical solutions throughout the creative development process

### **Success Looks Like**


* Building polished, responsive, and technically reliable playable ads
* Producing and iterating on playable and video creatives quickly and at high volume
* Creating reusable systems and templates that make creative production faster and more scalable
* Delivering playables that meet performance, loading time, file size, and platform requirements
* Using creative performance data and testing results to continuously improve concepts and execution
* Combining strong technical implementation with creative thinking and experimentation
* Contributing to AI\-assisted tools and workflows that improve creative production
* Collaborating effectively across creative, technical, product, and UA teams
* Taking strong ownership of creative concepts from prototype through testing and iteration

### **Qualifications**


* 4\+ years of experience in Unity game development, technical art, creative development, or a related field
* Strong proficiency in Unity and C\# and/or JavaScript
* Experience building gameplay systems, prototypes, playable ads, or interactive advertising experiences
* Strong understanding of mobile optimization, performance, and technical constraints
* Ability to combine technical implementation with creative thinking and fast prototyping
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, iterative, and performance\-driven environment

### **Bonus Points For**


* Experience with Luna Playable and playable ad platforms such as AppLovin, Unity Ads, Meta, or Google
* Experience creating playable ads, hypercasual/hybrid\-casual prototypes, or video creatives for mobile game UA
* Experience with motion graphics, animation, VFX, shaders, or technical art, using tools such as After Effects, Blender, or Unity Timeline
* Experience with AI\-assisted creative production, automation tools, or workflows
* A portfolio, GitHub, playable examples, or video creatives demonstrating relevant work


If this role excites you and you're ready to help shape the future of game development at Naphora, we encourage you to apply.

Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help us shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and have the opportunity to influence not only what we build, but also how we build it.

Increasingly, this means thinking about how we use AI to make software development more effective.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work as part of a product team together with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Depending on your experience and interests, your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and technical direction
Identifying and addressing technical debt where it creates meaningful value
Improving engineering practices, tools, and developer workflows
Driving or contributing to initiatives around infrastructure as code, DevOps, CI/CD, architecture, or developer tooling
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or development practices

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

We do not see AI as a replacement for strong engineering fundamentals. We see it as a tool that can make capable developers more effective when combined with technical judgment and a clear understanding of the problem being solved.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in this development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping us establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue developing your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Our primary technologies include:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
AWS
Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase, including opportunities to modernize and improve existing solutions.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

Your background

We expect that you:

Have solid professional software development experience
Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field
Have strong software engineering fundamentals
Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions
Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality
Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture
Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers
Are proactive and willing to challenge existing approaches when you see a better solution
Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality
Are interested in how AI and new development tools can improve your effectiveness as an engineer

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, cloud development, or AI-assisted development is an advantage, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to drive improvements beyond your immediate product work
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Interested?

If you are looking for a role where you can remain hands-on while gaining greater technical influence and helping shape how modern software is developed at Dalux, we would like to hear from you.

If you already use AI as part of your development workflow, we would also be interested to hear where you have found it genuinely useful – and where you have not.

We recruit continuously and hire multiple experienced developers throughout the year as Dalux grows.

About The Company

The Best of Both Worlds

At Maisa, we believe great work happens when people have the freedom to choose the setup that works best for them.

Prefer the flexibility of remote work?

You’re welcome to work remotely. Most of our roles are currently focused on Spain, although depending on the position and profile, we may be open to hiring from other locations.

Looking for some social energy?

Our hybrid setup gives you the option to connect and work alongside teammates at our hubs in Valencia, Barcelona, Madrid and Murcia

. And as we grow, our spaces will grow with us: when we build a team of more than 10 people in a location, our ambition is to create a hub there too.

We also want the time we spend together in person to be worth it. Today, that includes weekly transportation from the city center to our Valencia headquarters

and weekly team lunches in Valencia and Barcelona

, with more experiences to come as our teams and hubs evolve.

The Culture is OURS to Create

We’re still shaping how we work together—and that’s part of what makes joining Maisa now specifically exciting.

Everyone who joins has the opportunity to influence how we collaborate, connect, and build our culture. Rather than inheriting a finished playbook, you’ll have a voice in creating it.

Remote when you want flexibility. Together when you want connection. And a culture you can help shape from day one.

Welcome to Maisa – Making AI Accountable!

Maisa is building the next generation of Agentic Process Automation
, helping enterprises automate complex, decision-heavy processes that traditional automation can’t handle and GenAI alone can’t be trusted with. Our platform combines AI-driven reasoning with deterministic execution, enabling reliable, auditable, and enterprise-ready AI systems.

About The Role…

We’re seeking Forward Deployed Engineers to work at the intersection of engineering, product, and customers, deploying and adapting Maisa Studio
, our flagship Agentic Process Automation platform, to solve real-world enterprise problems.

Customer-Facing Engineering
Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their processes and goals. Design and implement solutions using Maisa Studio to automate complex workflows, acting as a trusted technical partner during onboarding and deployment while translating requirements into technical implementations and product feedback.

Collaboration & Product Feedback
Partner with product and engineering teams to influence roadmap development. Surface customer needs, edge cases, and scalability concerns while defining best practices, reference architectures, and reusable components that accelerate delivery.

Reliability, Security & Quality
Ensure deployments meet enterprise standards for reliability, performance, and security. Support customers in regulated environments by aligning with compliance requirements and collaborating with QA, SRE, and AppSec teams for stable rollouts.

What You’ll Do…

You will work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to deliver robust, secure, and maintainable deployments in complex, often regulated environments, across 2 key technical domains:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Configure, extend, and integrate Maisa Studio into customer environments, designing end-to-end solutions that include APIs, connectors, webhooks, serverless functions, microservices, and event-driven flows. Translate functional requirements from Automators and Technical Account Managers into concrete technical implementations using Go, Python, or JavaScript, clarifying ambiguities and proposing pragmatic paths forward. Ensure robustness through strong engineering practices including testing, logging, monitoring, and documentation. Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and support handover to internal teams or customers when applicable.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. 

Based in the beautiful city of Porto, you’ll be part of our collaborative Engineering & Development teams, working closely with your peers and decision-makers to maintain and develop our global services and products.

As a Software Engineer, you are a builder who bridges the gap between high-level requirements and high-performance reality. Having advanced past foundational concepts, you are currently dedicated to growing your expertise in designing distributed systems that scale effectively. You don't just write code that works; you write code that thrives under the pressure of global data scales.

You will be an integral part of the development cycle, owning features from design to deployment. Working within an agile team, you’ll encounter exciting technical challenges, from low-latency optimizations to complex B2B integrations, in a culture where your voice is heard and your growth is prioritized.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Service Evolution:
Develop and maintain our core backend and middleware services, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and ready for global traffic.

Architectural Input:
Don't just follow blueprints, help draw them. By collaborating with more senior colleagues, you’ll participate in the design of software architectures that solve real-world business problems.

Data at Scale:
Write highly efficient code capable of handling massive amounts of data with ease.

Performance Engineering:
Implement performance-critical and low-latency solutions where every millisecond counts.

Production Insight:
Keep the services you build healthy in production. You'll instrument, monitor, and log them, then use those signals to debug real live issues, with support from the team as you ramp up.

Collaborative Growth:
Work within a peer-led environment where you’ll receive mentorship to constantly level up the team’s collective skill set.

Code Craftsmanship:
Actively participate in code reviews, advocating for "clean code" principles and maintainability.

Global Integration:
Build and support B2B integrations with partners and clients across the world, ensuring our data flows seamlessly across the ecosystem.

WHO YOU ARE

The Foundation:
You hold a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or have a similar technical background. You have 2+ years of professional experience in a comparable software engineering role.

OOP Specialist:
You have a strong grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and understand how to apply design patterns to keep complex systems manageable.

Comfortable with .NET (or eager to learn):
You are comfortable using .NET/C# or similar C based languages
. While we value core engineering principles, you’ll be hitting the ground running in a working .NET environment.

Distributed Thinker:
You have "hands-on" experience (or a very strong conceptual understanding) of Microservices and how they communicate in a distributed world.

Tooling Savvy:
You are a fluent Git user and feel right at home in a terminal, perhaps even wielding PowerShell or Bash to automate your daily workflow.

Clean Code Advocate:
You believe that code is read more often than it is written. You take pride in naming, structure, and documentation. You recognize technical debt when you see it and work with the team to chip away at it.

Test-Minded:
You treat automated tests as part of “done”, not an afterthought. You write tests alongside your code so it stays robust and so the next person can change it safely.

Security & Privacy Conscious:
You apply basic security and privacy principles by default, handle user data responsibly without exception, and raise a flag early when you spot a concern.

Agile Mindset:
You thrive in a collaborative environment. You understand that "Agile" is about iterative value, transparency, and constant feedback. You can size and prioritize your own work with input from the team, and you raise a hand early when something drifts off track.

Great Communicator:
You have strong conversational English skills (written and spoken) and enjoy the dynamic of working with colleagues from different time zones and cultures.
